chunk: Product Overview: Cloudly is a secure, simple cloud storage for individuals and small teams. Plans include Basic (50 GB), Plus (500 GB), and Pro (2 TB). All plans include desktop and mobile apps, file version history for 30 days, and encrypted transfers (TLS).
Pricing: Basic $2.99/month, Plus $7.99/month, Pro $14.99/month. Annual billing saves ~15%. Team add-on: $4/user/month (Plus or Pro only). A 14-day free trial is available on all tiers.
Security: Files in transit use TLS 1.3. At rest, data is encrypted with AES-256. Two-factor authentication via TOTP or SMS is supported. Admins can enforce MFA and session timeouts on team plans.
Integrations: Cloudly integrates with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack (share links and previews), and Zapier for automation. Public link sharing supports expiration dates and passwords.
Support & Refunds: Standard support via email and chat. Plus/Pro get priority chat. Refunds: monthly plans refundable within 7 days of charge; annual plans within 30 days on a pro‑rated basis.
Enterprise: SSO (SAML/SCIM) and data residency are available on Enterprise contracts. Contact sales for details and pricing.
